approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: Merging main through #969 into #900 needs one line in #969's new test a_send_back_answers_review_order_by_attempt_count_and_falls_back_to_time: its ScopedReviewRecord literal gets relayed_by: None, the field #900 adds, as #900's own fixtures already do. Without it the merged tree does not compile. This change only declares that file; no spec text and no other code changes.
acceptance_criteria: A review an agent records for a person can carry the same record, shown the same way.
The change's status shows it beside the approval or review it belongs to.

answers.constraints: change.3md 'Approvals are claims; relayed decisions (#633)': a record written without a relay omits relayed_by, so a fixture built as a struct literal says relayed_by: None, as #900's own fixtures do. change.3md 'Cancel by position, not by digest' (#960): the line leaves #969's send-back ordering test unchanged in what it checks. This change only declares one test file the merge of main changed; no spec text and no other code change. Leif chose the second covering change, criteria SHIP-2.e and CHANGE-13.b verbatim (2026-11-06, relayed by orc t18). Never weaken a gate, bound or test.
